PRE_IMPLEMENTATION_REUSE_GATE.featureName: OpenKore Supply and Combat Configuration UI Replacement

currentProject.evidence: Existing Player Web supply form and skill-automation controls are in ops/ro-stack/dashboard/index.html and app.js; /api/supply-cycle and /api/skill-automation have separate legacy handlers in ops/ro-stack/dashboard.mjs. The replacement keeps the existing read projection and moves policy editing to one /api/config contract.

legacyProject.evidence: docs/openkore-harvest-registry.md and docs/openkore-reference/reference-index.yml identify the historical supply, loot, target, skill and storage behavior used here.

reuseRegistry.reference: ops/research/external-reuse-registry.json; docs/openkore-reference/reference-index.yml topics ATTACK_AUTO, INVENTORY_LOOT, SHOP_BUY, SHOP_SELL, STORAGE, SUPPLY_AUTOMATION

rAthena.evidence: Current rAthena source remains the authority for inventory amount, weight, item capacity, storage and shop transactions. This task adds no native executor and the adapter explicitly reports CONFIG_ONLY_NO_EXECUTOR_COMMAND.

openKore.evidence: Authorized local reference .local/ro-stack/openkore at commit 51de1ddfc4449ae5217f6886de702f87ca934030: src/AI/Attack.pm, src/Misc.pm, control/config.txt, items_control.txt, pickupitems.txt, mon_control.txt, src/Interface/Wx/ConfigEditor.pm and plugins/xConf/xConf.pl.

externalEcosystem.reason: The replacement uses the authorized local OpenKore and rAthena references; no external runtime dependency or engine is introduced.

genericOSS.reason: The browser form needs the existing Dashboard security and styles; a generic editor library would add an unnecessary runtime dependency.

PRE_IMPLEMENTATION_REUSE_GATE.whyNotReuse: OpenKore runtime and Wx/Perl UI are historical references only. Their mature field names, grouping and repeated-block behavior are portable; their executor and GUI implementation are not the Dashboard authority.

registryUpdate.evidence: The accompanying audit records the current upstream commit, exact local source paths, field semantics, UI grouping reuse and the CONFIG_ONLY capability boundary.
